title: feat(ui): show the operator side at the work envelope
body:
## What changed

The viewport now shows the operator side of the work envelope. An arrow starts at the lower edge of the operator-side face. The arrow points out of the envelope, toward the operator. The text "Operator side" is at the tip of the arrow.

- `camcraft-post`: a machine file can state `general.operator_side`. The words are `"-X"`, `"+X"`, `"-Y"` and `"+Y"`. The word names the world axis that points from the envelope to the operator.
  - The field is optional. Old machine files and old projects load without a change.
  - A wrong word refuses the file by name. A wrong word never reads as the default.
  - `OperatorSide::default_for` gives the default of each machine kind: `+Y` for a lathe, `-Y` (the front) for each other kind.
- `camcraft-ui`: `operator_side.rs` builds the arrow when its input changes (the placed envelope and the side). Each other frame reads the kept arrow. The text is screen text, so it stays readable when the view turns.
- The View door has a new box, "Show operator side". It is view state: on by default, no command, not saved. It is disabled while the work envelope is off.
- The arrow and the text use the envelope colour. They are outside the envelope, so they do not cover the part or the toolpath.
- Docs: `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` (the machine file grammar) and `docs/decisions/2632-operator-side.md` (the defaults for each kind).

## Cause

This is new work that the maintainer asked for. The viewport did not show from which side the operator looks into the work envelope.

## Before and after screenshots

Both captures use the seeded shell at 1280 × 720 with the HAAS VF-2 machine file mounted and the work envelope shown. The camera looks from the front. "Before" is the same scene with the new box off. With the box off, the scene is the same as on `upstream/main`.

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/716acb4411ebb971886b4c98b17eeeb805770f76/2632/operator-side-before.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/716acb4411ebb971886b4c98b17eeeb805770f76/2632/operator-side-after.png) |

The screenshots are only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. A temporary collector made them. The collector is not in this branch.

## Tests

Pins in `crates/post/tests/operator_side.rs`:

- `an_old_file_without_the_field_loads_and_takes_the_default_of_its_kind` (also loads each library `.mch` file)
- `each_kind_has_its_documented_default_side`
- `a_file_that_names_a_side_keeps_it_over_the_default`
- `a_wrong_word_refuses_the_file_by_name`
- `a_stored_machine_without_the_field_still_reads_and_a_stated_side_round_trips`

Pins in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/operator_side.rs`:

- `a_mill_shows_the_arrow_and_the_text_on_its_default_side`
- `each_machine_kind_shows_the_arrow_on_its_default_side`
- `a_lathe_shows_the_arrow_on_the_viewer_side_of_the_turning_plane` (checks the cylinder surface and outward direction for the default and all four stated sides)
- `a_machine_that_names_a_side_moves_the_arrow_to_it` (also through the file text)
- `no_envelope_means_no_arrow_and_no_text`
- `the_switch_hides_and_shows_the_arrow_and_the_text_as_view_state`
- `a_still_frame_builds_no_arrow_and_a_changed_input_builds_one` (the frame-cost counter test)

The pins do not compile on `upstream/main`, because the types are new. Mutation checks, each restored after the run:

1. The parser does not read `general.operator_side`: 2 post pins go red.
2. The scene draws the envelope without the arrow: 3 UI pins go red.
3. The cache builds the arrow again on each frame: the counter pin goes red.
4. The draw ignores the "Show operator side" box: the switch pin goes red.
5. The lathe uses the old anchor at the corner of its bounding box: the lathe surface pin goes red at `[-60, 60, -97]`. Restore the cylinder projection: the pin passes (1 passed).

Final-head verification (`9cf25fd20db55a3198b53180cdcb64644c222b25`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 96 steps passed in 12.2 minutes. Test totals: 2,311 passed, 0 failed, 9 ignored.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: green in 136.0 minutes. All 204 steps completed (1 release build and 203 app heavy target steps). There were 44 passed tests and 2 expected failures (#1950 and #2849). The gate accepted both expected failures. No unexpected failures occurred.
- `cargo clippy -j2 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed in 17 minutes 54 seconds.

The shared sccache did not answer. The final gate runs use `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

## Goldens moved

None. No posted G-code and no golden file changes. No check, post or simulation reads the new field.

## Not exercised

- The pixel snapshot lane (release tier). No snapshot PNG changes in this PR.
- The machine file editor has no row for the field. A user writes the field in the file text. The decision file records this.

## Overlaps

- #3057 touches `collect_overlay` in `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`. It adds two lines there. This PR changes a different line of the same list. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- Other open PRs touch `crates/ui/src/state.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` in other places. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- The earlier plan stacked this work on #2835. #2835 is merged, so this PR is against `main`.

Effort: high

Changelog: The viewport shows an arrow and the text "Operator side" at the work envelope. A machine file can name the side with `general.operator_side`; the View door has a switch to hide them.

Fixes #2632
